comment: What a GraalVM native image cannot work out for itself, and it is one thing.
MemoryLock calls mlock/munlock - on Windows VirtualLock/VirtualUnlock - through
the foreign linker, so that the pages holding a secret are never written to swap.
A downcall has to be registered at build time; without this entry the image builds
and then fails on the first connection with MissingForeignRegistrationError.
Found by building one on 22.09.2026 rather than by reasoning about it, and written
by GraalVM's own tracing agent rather than by hand - the signature below is jint
(void*, jlong), which is both mlock and munlock.
Nothing else is needed. The drivers are found through ServiceLoader, which an image
handles without help, and there is no reflection anywhere in the distribution -
see NoReflectionTest, which keeps it that way.
